Advice — іменник, незлічуваний (some adv: Advice is an uncountable noun (some advice); advise is a verb: to tell someone what to do.
Affect — дієслово «впливати»; effect — і: Affect is a verb: to change something; effect is a noun: a result or change.
Alone — сам, без інших (факт; не стоїть: Alone — without other people (a fact; not used before a noun); lonely — sad because you are alone (a lonely man).
Another — ще один (з одниною); other — і: Another — one more (with singular); other — with plural, or the other — the second of two.
Borrow — брати в когось на час; lend — д: Borrow — take from someone for a time; lend — give to someone for a time.
Bring — сюди, до мовця; take — туди, від: Bring — here, towards the speaker; take — there, away from the speaker.
Cook — a person who cooks; cooker — the machine you cook on.
Economic — пов'язаний з економікою; econ: Economic — about the economy; economical — saving money, not wasteful.
Few — з лічильними (few people); little: Few — with countable nouns (few people); little — with uncountable nouns (little time).
Fit — підходить за розміром; suit — пасу: Fit — the right size; suit — looks good on someone or is convenient for them.
Fun — приємно, весело проводити час; fun: Fun — enjoyable, a good time; funny — makes you laugh (or strange).
Hard — наполегливо, сильно; hardly — лед: Hard — with a lot of effort; hardly — almost not.
Hear — чути (звук сам доходить); listen: Hear — a sound reaches you without trying; listen to — pay attention to a sound.
History — історія як минуле чи наука; st: History — the past, or the subject at school; story — a tale someone tells.
Job — лічильне, конкретна посада (a job): Job — countable, a particular position (a job); work — uncountable, work in general or your workplace.
Late — пізно, із запізненням; lately — о: Late — not on time; lately — recently.
Lose — загубити річ чи програти; miss —: Lose — not find a thing, or not win; miss — be too late for transport, or feel sad that someone is not with you.
Make — створювати щось нове (cake, noise: Make — create something new (cake, noise, a decision); do — perform an action or a task (homework, a favour).
Many — з лічильними (many friends); much: Many — with countable nouns (many friends); much — with uncountable nouns (much money).
Mean — означати, мати на увазі; think —: Mean — have a meaning, or want to say; think — have an opinion.
Remember — пам'ятати самому; remind — на: Remember — keep something in your own mind; remind — help someone else remember (remind me to…).
Rise — підніматися самому (без додатка);: Rise — go up by itself (no object); raise — lift something (raise your hand, raise money).
See — бачити (без зусиль); look at — див: See — notice with your eyes, no effort; look at — turn your eyes to something; watch — look at something that moves (TV, a match).
Sell — дієслово «продавати»; sale — імен: Sell is a verb: give something for money; sale is a noun: the act of selling, or low prices.
Sensible — розсудливий, практичний; sens: Sensible — wise and practical; sensitive — easily hurt or upset, or quick to notice feelings.
Steal — річ (steal a bike); rob — людину: Steal — a thing (steal a bike); rob — a person or a place (rob a bank, rob someone).
Tall — високий на зріст (людина, дерево): Tall — a person or tree from bottom to top; high — far above the ground, or a big level (prices, voice).
Tell — комусь (tell me); say — самі слов: Tell — to someone (tell me); say — the words themselves (say hello); speak — use a language, or talk in general.
Trip — лічильне, конкретна поїздка (a tr: Trip — countable, one journey (a trip); travel — uncountable, travelling in general.
Win — перемогти в змаганні чи виграти пр: Win — a competition or a prize; beat — another player or team; earn — get money for work.
Калька «актуальний»: current — теперішні: Common mix-up: current — happening now; actual — real, true.
Калька «відвідувати»: attend — бути прис: Common mix-up: attend — be present at (lectures, a meeting); visit — go to see a person or a place.
Калька «евентуально»: eventually — зрешт: Common mix-up: eventually — in the end, after a long time; possibly — maybe.
Калька «здавати іспит»: take — складати: Common mix-up: take an exam — sit it; pass — get a good enough result.
Калька «контролювати»: check — перевірят: Common mix-up: check — look to see if something is right; control — have power over, direct.
Калька «магазин»: shop — крамниця; magaz: Common mix-up: shop — a place where you buy things; magazine — a thin paper you read.
Калька «місце»: seat — місце, щоб сидіти: Common mix-up: seat — somewhere to sit (in a hall, on a bus); place — any location.
Калька «навчати»: teach — навчати когось: Common mix-up: teach — give knowledge to someone; learn — get knowledge yourself.
Калька «пропонувати»: offer — дати щось: Common mix-up: offer — say you will give something (offer you a drink); suggest — give an idea (I suggest we…).
Калька «рецепт»: prescription — від ліка: Common mix-up: prescription — from a doctor; recipe — for cooking; receipt — paper you get after paying.
Калька «симпатичний»: good-looking — при: Common mix-up: good-looking — attractive; sympathetic — showing you understand someone's problems.
Калька «фабрика»: factory — фабрика, зав: Common mix-up: factory — a building where things are made; fabric — cloth.
Калька «чекати»: wait — чекати певний ча: Common mix-up: wait — stay until something happens; expect — think something will probably happen.
